approach: Backfill the two unspecified halves of doctor's finding set, give the shared report shape a node of its own, and move the doctor-to-repair contract out of the repair node into workflows/. Derive every claim from the implementation and its tests; where the two disagree, report rather than normalize.
Blast radius: spec corpus and tests only. No source module changes and nothing published changes, so no changeset.

Two concurrent missions touch the same surface. Sequenced #60 first and rebased onto it rather than specifying a shape about to change; held cli/entry-point/ open for #61 rather than writing a node for a change this CR is not making.

why: Three judge rounds. Round one failed the oracle lens on a false claim in the report-shape node; round two failed builder and architect on three more, including a deduplication rule the shipped table cannot reach and whose test could not have caught it; round three passed oracle and architect and failed builder on two deterministic checks - duplicate scenario-map edge/path pairs and one test title drifted from its scenario. Both re-run to green with the gate own tools: check-suite, check-spec-state, scenario-overlap and spec-structure all clear, 85 scenarios exact-title bridged to passing tests, verify green at 100 percent coverage. Self-asserted within the derived auto-spec leash; the substantive lenses passed and the failing lens failed only on mechanically reproducible checks that now reproduce clean.

what: The concept-index generator resolves node paths by slicing the spec directory prefix and only finds nodes when run from inside the spec directory, where it then emits truncated paths. The generated by-concept table in the project spec is consequently empty even though every node now carries a concept tag. Left empty rather than hand-written, since the block is marked as generated. Pre-existing; not introduced by this change request.

The shipped repair skill routes findings by looking for a skill name in the help section, which is present for four of seventeen problems and for none of the four configuration faults the skill exists to correct. It also contradicts the route-on-problem rule stated two paragraphs above it in the same file. Filed on the forge.

A bridge finding reports a bridge whose status is ok when only the git index is wrong, so it is filed in the bridge family while describing something other than bridge resolution. Specified as it ships; filed on the forge.

Three surfaces of this package still have no spec node: the init skill's write behavior, which every instruction-bridge repair routes to; the shared output encoder used by both commands; and the CLI entry-point contract, whose home is held open for a concurrent mission. All three recorded as backfill gaps in the CLI index and the project spec.

The spec-judge reported that its pre-flight could not be exercised because the conductor did not relay the inline spec-producer declared governance set through the dispatch channel. Raised on all three rounds of this change request and on the preceding one, so it is a gap in the dispatch path rather than a one-off omission.
